name: Anna P. Heffernan
bioAdditions: In 1900 "Annie," 23, was a tailoress in her parents' Plymouth home (S9). FamilySearch names her daughter Mary Florence Murphy (1902-1951), who married James F. Poland; that Luzerne marriage record names her mother as Anna Heffernan (S1). FS gives Felix Murphy's birth as 1876 and death 22 Apr 1955; his parents were John Felix Murphy (1851-1890) and Mary Kelly (S2).
